📝 Developer Implementation Notes (For the APK Team):
1. Image Caching: When updating the avatar, ensure the mobile app caches the new
avatar_url or forces a UI refresh, as the URL path will change upon successful upload
to prevent browser/app caching of the old image.
2. Payload Size: The Gradebook endpoint returns a comprehensive dataset. Ensure you
parse this asynchronously on the mobile side so it doesn't block the main UI thread.
3. Null Values: The student's grade field might be null if they haven't been assigned to a
class yet. Account for null safety in the app UI
